entries.title: Show HN: ImpromptuDo.com the real time location based activity partner finder
entries.author: djb_hackernews
entries.current_title: Show HN: ImpromptuDo.com the real time location based activity partner finder
entries.excerpt:
http://impromptudo.com is a small project I've been working on. Just a webapp for now but I think it qualifies as an MVP. Also has a mobile version at the same url or http://m.impromptudo.com. Right now it pulls in data from meetup.com for upcoming meetups in several populous cities so it's not just an empty map. You can also click on the map to put up your own post. Trying to stay away from making it all social networky, there are plenty of those already.

entries.guide_zh: ImpromptuDo 按位置实时寻找一起活动的人，把临时兴趣变成线下安排。

entries.title: Show HN: Facster.com technology demonstration
entries.author: jackfoxy
entries.excerpt: I am presenting for your consideration not so much the Facster.com website (a prototype with some rough edges) but the underlying technology. I’ve long been dissatisfied with the availability and presentation of raw data on the internet. entries.guide_zh: Facster 以原型网站展示背后的技术，作者希望讨论实现而非仅看成品。
